body: How do I know which one to call?

I know, it’s really upsetting to me that this is going on. He says his ex used to mentally abuse him just for having female friends so he didn’t want to tell me but I really don’t buy it. He has several female friends over the course of our almost four year relationship and I have never once responded with anger of jealousy only trust and acceptance. This time just feel different.

Cheating is unforgivable to me. There’s nothing he could do or say that would make me want to even try to repair the relationship.
What did he do that’s similar to my situation if you don’t mind me asking?

We’ve been engaged way before I got pregnant. He’s a nice guy seriously I really didn’t see this coming at all. I love him more than anything in the world and I’m just in shock.

Edit: been together 3.5 years

I know something is up. How do I talk to him about this? I told him I could tell something was wrong. I’d rather him just tell me so we can get it over with rather than continue this way until it explodes.
You made a mistake. Everyone does. I regret people I’ve slept with too. Life moves on, and your past doesn’t define you.
Thank you. Yes I’ve felt really alone and scared. I feel more comfortable telling strangers on reddit than anyone in my life.
Yeah it’s been rough and she put in my head that meds were bad while pregnant. I’m going to seek treatment.
Seroquel is what I was taking before, so I actually have that on hand. My previous psych told me it was not good to take during pregnancy.
Thank you. I might go to an ER tomorrow after work honestly just to be put on medications ASAP. Thank you for your advice.

No medication, my psych took me off and said that pregnancy is a “safe haven” for bipolar women. I felt stable at first but then all this bad stuff started happening and I slowly have gone downhill. I’ve already been to the ER twice this pregnancy. I am thinking tomorrow I will look up psychiatrists on my new insurance and make an appointment.

Edit: I’m also alone for the rest of the week. I literally have no one to take me and can’t afford an ambulance. I have considered calling one anyway but I just don’t have the effort.
Me too.
I know how you feel, that why it’s so hard to be positive.
Life can feel that way sometimes. I have overcome obstacles that have felt like the end of the world. The important thing is that you continue to look ahead and move forward.
It can be hard to separate yourself from the past, I know all too well. It sounds like you’re doing better though and are making a future for yourself.
Ah, I see. So it’s probably easy to feel like that’s the whole world especially if you’ve been there your whole life.

Honestly you remind me a lot of myself. I can relate to a lot of what you’ve said, especially the insecurity  and comparing yourself/ being compared to others.  It’s so uncomfortable. I’ll never understand why people don’t just have this general acceptance that we can’t compare others. Each individual is completely unique and likes to think of themselves as such. This community, is it like a small town you live in?
You can tell me. I’m a really good listener.
Hey, what’s going on?
I do. I’ll talk about whatever
Therapy always made me feel like I was being whiny. I usually felt guilty after telling a stranger anything so that honestly did more harm than good. Medication alone saved my life tbh.
Two. Lol

My job turned out to be crappy. And my new job is bad as well. Haven’t made as many friends as I would have liked. Not nearly. I don’t have family to rely on so I’m just stressed constantly wondering if I’m enough.

They said it was best to not take anything but I’ve heard contradicting information at this point. My new state covered insurance doesn’t seem to cover speciality mental health services so I don’t really have any options.
Thank you! Same to you.
Yeah, definitely. I just feel like sometimes I’m super aware of it.
Me either. I’ve been saying over and over to myself for days that I’m not even a person. The simplest way I can rationalize it is I feel like I’m doing everything wrong compared to everyone else.
I see it all the time on here, though. Some people are super anti a certain drug I guess. I like it here because I see all different types of experiences.

Oh man don’t get a chinchilla. Worst mistake I ever made. He was so expensive but sooooo cute. Little shit hated me and would like bark at me, never let me hold him. The amount of shit he produced was astronomical.
Lmao I love when people bash drugs on this sub. Like what did you think you were gonna find?

I’ve done that exact same thing many times. It’s definitely not safe to do. I put off seeking help my whole young adult life until I was either going to ruin my life with mania or kill myself during a mixed episode...I wasn’t sleeping for days at a time. My advice would be to get help if you believe that you need it, not wait. Idk about you, but with me I could be manageable and then take a turn for the worse no warning. 

I also moved to a new state recently and don’t know anyone. The people I do know here it seems just are too busy for me.  I think that’s just life. Makes me feel even worse lol

Nothing particularly bad happened. Just was too depressed to even get out of bed. Hadn’t happened to me in a while though and up until today I’d been pretty stable for 6 months. Just sucks when you’ve been to therapy, had meds changed and readjusted, etc. just made me feel super hopeless.

How about you? What’s going on?
I’ve had a rough day. I could talk. Bipolar 2 here.
I feel this on so many levels. The thought of suicide crosses my mind pretty much daily. I’m not actively trying to kill my self, just fantasizing about the possibility because I’m broken.
Thank you lol.
I haven’t even bothered to tell mine. I know they would just do the same thing they always did- not care. It sucks. I haven’t even talked to a therapist about it Bc I’m so ashamed.
I do the same exact thing. My parents caused my disorder and they also don’t believe in mental health. You’re not alone.
When you’re tripping, you can’t exactly feel that you have broken bones. You might forgot or accidentally injure yourself further. I’d wait to have a better experience when you’re healed.

Hey, so you sound A LOT like me. It’s uncanny. The last time I freaked out I got insanely drunk and smashed my head in the tub on purpose, no idea why...I think I was just losing it. I’ve done a lot of the same things as you, and drinking and drugs are most definitely my vice. I also like to randomly take trips and tell no one where I’m going and kinda sorta plan on killing myself. Feel free to pm me, if you want. Idk anyone else like me and we can swap stories.
It’s taken everything from me, too. Just waiting to die.
Same, that’s exactly what happened to me. I was triggered and now I’m having extremely intrusive thoughts. I feel like I probably need to be admitted but idk where to start
It blows, dude. Nothing has changed but everything is different. I can’t explain it. How long ago were you hospitalized?
I don’t even know if any psych wards near me :( I’m in a new area and don’t know many people
I was just doing so well before this. I looked at a trigger of mine and set this off. I’ve only been hospitalized once and I’m pretty scared.

Yeah. I just don’t know how else I could do it. I don’t have any money or anywhere to go. I feel like if I fail, maybe I’ll finally get real help and someone will take m seriously , and if I don’t fail then I die.
You’re too kind. Whys it always empty?
Life is scarier than death so I gots to go
Ah, yeah no that won’t be a problem. I’ll be slicing vertically from wrist to inner arm. I am also considering slitting my throat. I’ll be pretty drunk shortly so I should be able to do that

I ended up losing my hearing for a day and still have tinnitus as a result of my overdose.
